name: locatorstress
description: Playwright locator stress lab for reproducible locator resolution experiments.

scripts.dev: npm run build && node dist/cli/index.js dev
scripts.demo: npm run build && node dist/cli/index.js demo
scripts.analyze: npm run build && node dist/cli/index.js analyze
scripts.search: npm run build && node dist/cli/index.js search
scripts.export: npm run build && node dist/cli/index.js export
scripts.test:e2e:custom: npm run build && vitest run tests/e2e/custom-input.test.ts
scripts.test:cli: npm run build && vitest run tests/cli/
scripts.test:ui: npm run build && vitest run tests/ui/ui-flow.test.ts
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && vitest run tests/e2e/e2e-main-flow.test.ts
scripts.test:offline: npm run build && vitest run tests/e2e/offline.test.ts
scripts.test:performance: npm run build && vitest run tests/e2e/performance.test.ts
scripts.test:stress: npm run build && vitest run tests/e2e/stress.test.ts
scripts.test:oracle: npm run s0:locator-oracle && npm run test:s0:fixtures && npm run test:s0:mutations
